newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end firmer on blue-chips, Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end firmer on blue-chips, Wall St.

text.p: Brazilian stocks closed firmer on Wednesday, extending Tuesday's rally, boosted by interest in blue-chips and further Wall Street gains, traders said.

The Sao Paulo bourse's Bovespa index rose 840 points to close at 66,058 points. Market turnover improved, totalling a heavy 442.2 million reais ($433.1 million), after consecutive sessions of mild trade.
Bellwether Telebras preferred led the market's rise once again, climbing 1.23 percent to end at 82.40 reais.
